toefl:se:152.answer: For instance, customer service, classroom teaching, or even surgery depend heavily on real-time decision-making and communication, which no textbook can fully simulate.
toefl:se:152.fullSentence: For instance, customer service, classroom teaching, or even surgery depend heavily on real-time decision-making and communication, which no textbook can fully simulate.
toefl:se:152.japanese: 例えば、接客業や教室での指導、さらには外科手術さえも、リアルタイムの意思決定とコミュニケーションに大きく依存しており、これはどんな教科書も完全には再現できません。
toefl:se:152.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:152.explanation: depend heavily onで「〜に大きく依存する」を表す。
toefl:se:152.relatedInfo: rely on split-second judgment / require live interaction
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強1

toefl:se:153.answer: Therefore, the most effective education combines both theory and practical experience.
toefl:se:153.fullSentence: Therefore, the most effective education combines both theory and practical experience.
keyPhrases: combines both theory and practical experience
toefl:se:153.japanese: したがって、最も効果的な教育は理論と実践経験の両方を組み合わせたものです。
toefl:se:153.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:153.explanation: combine A and Bで「AとBを組み合わせる」を表す。
toefl:se:153.relatedInfo: blend theory with practice / integrate classroom and hands-on learning
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強1

toefl:se:154.answer: Theory provides concepts and frameworks, while hands-on work—such as internships, labs, or part-time jobs—allows students to test and refine their knowledge.
toefl:se:154.fullSentence: Theory provides concepts and frameworks, while hands-on work—such as internships, labs, or part-time jobs—allows students to test and refine their knowledge.
toefl:se:154.japanese: 理論は概念や枠組みを提供し、インターンシップや実験、アルバイトのような実践的な活動は学生が自分の知識を試し磨き上げることを可能にします。
toefl:se:154.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:154.explanation: allow 人 to doで「人が〜することを可能にする」を表す。
toefl:se:154.relatedInfo: apply and sharpen their knowledge / put learning into practice
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強1

toefl:se:155.answer: This integration prepares students not only to understand their field, but also to perform confidently in it.
toefl:se:155.fullSentence: This integration prepares students not only to understand their field, but also to perform confidently in it.
toefl:se:155.japanese: この統合は、学生が自分の分野を理解するだけでなく、その中で自信を持って実践できるように準備させます。
toefl:se:155.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:155.explanation: prepare 人 to doで「人が〜する準備をさせる」を表す。
toefl:se:155.relatedInfo: build both knowledge and confidence / equip students fully
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強1

toefl:se:156.answer: In my opinion, practical experience is more important than learning from classes and books.
toefl:se:156.fullSentence: In my opinion, practical experience is more important than learning from classes and books.
keyPhrases: than learning from classes and books
toefl:se:156.japanese: 私の意見では、実践経験は授業や本からの学習よりも重要です。
toefl:se:156.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:156.explanation: more A than Bの比較表現。
toefl:se:156.relatedInfo: outweighs classroom learning / matters more than book knowledge
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強2

toefl:se:157.answer: There are limits to what we can learn from reading or lectures.
toefl:se:157.fullSentence: There are limits to what we can learn from reading or lectures.
keyPhrases: limits to what we can learn
toefl:se:157.japanese: 読書や講義から学べることには限界があります。
toefl:se:157.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:157.relatedInfo: has its limitations / can only teach so much
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強2

toefl:se:158.answer: For example, as Andrew mentioned, working in a shop requires skills like talking to customers and handling problems, which you can only develop by actually doing the job.
toefl:se:158.fullSentence: For example, as Andrew mentioned, working in a shop requires skills like talking to customers and handling problems, which you can only develop by actually doing the job.
keyPhrases: talking to customers and handling problems
only develop by actually doing the job
toefl:se:158.japanese: 例えば、アンドリューが述べたように、お店で働くことは客と話したり問題に対応したりするスキルを必要とし、それらは実際に仕事をすることでしか身につけられません。
toefl:se:158.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:158.explanation: can only doで「〜することでしかできない」という限定表現。
toefl:se:158.relatedInfo: build skills on the job / learn by doing
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強2

toefl:se:159.answer: Also, making mistakes and learning from them during real practice helps us understand things faster and remember them better.
toefl:se:159.fullSentence: Also, making mistakes and learning from them during real practice helps us understand things faster and remember them better.
keyPhrases: making mistakes and learning from them
toefl:se:159.japanese: また、実際の練習の中で間違いを犯しそこから学ぶことは、物事をより早く理解しよりよく記憶する助けになります。
toefl:se:159.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:159.explanation: learn from mistakesで「失敗から学ぶ」という定型表現。
toefl:se:159.relatedInfo: learn through trial and error / gain deeper understanding through practice
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強2

toefl:se:160.answer: While books and classes are useful for background knowledge, practical experience teaches valuable skills that are hard to get in any other way.
toefl:se:160.fullSentence: While books and classes are useful for background knowledge, practical experience teaches valuable skills that are hard to get in any other way.
keyPhrases: hard to get in any other way
toefl:se:160.japanese: 本や授業は背景知識を得るのに役立ちますが、実践経験は他の方法では得難い貴重なスキルを教えてくれます。
toefl:se:160.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:160.explanation: hard to get in any other wayで「他に方法がないほど得難い」を強調する。
toefl:se:160.relatedInfo: provide essential background / offer irreplaceable skills
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強2

toefl:se:161.answer: For these reasons, I believe practical experience is better in education.
toefl:se:161.fullSentence: For these reasons, I believe practical experience is better in education.
keyPhrases: practical experience is better in education
toefl:se:161.japanese: これらの理由から、教育においては実践経験の方が優れていると私は考えます。
toefl:se:161.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:161.explanation: For these reasonsは結論を導く定型表現。
toefl:se:161.relatedInfo: is the more valuable approach / proves more effective overall
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強2

toefl:se:162.answer: I strongly prefer preparing a presentation gradually over several weeks because it leads to a clearer message and more confident delivery.
toefl:se:162.fullSentence: I strongly prefer preparing a presentation gradually over several weeks because it leads to a clearer message and more confident delivery.
toefl:se:162.japanese: 私は数週間かけて徐々にプレゼンの準備をすることを強く好みます。なぜなら、それはより明確なメッセージとより自信のある発表につながるからです。
toefl:se:162.explanation: prefer -ingで「〜することを好む」を表す。
toefl:se:162.relatedInfo: take a step-by-step approach / build up preparation over time

toefl:se:163.answer: When I start early, I have time to research thoroughly, select the most relevant information, and organize my ideas logically.
toefl:se:163.fullSentence: When I start early, I have time to research thoroughly, select the most relevant information, and organize my ideas logically.
toefl:se:163.japanese: 早く始めれば、徹底的に調査し、最も関連性の高い情報を選び、自分の考えを論理的に整理する時間が持てます。
toefl:se:163.explanation: have time to doで「〜する時間がある」を表す。
toefl:se:163.relatedInfo: do in-depth research / structure ideas logically

toefl:se:164.answer: This usually leads to a more coherent structure, with a clear introduction, strong supporting points, and a memorable conclusion, which is difficult to achieve when rushing at the last minute.
toefl:se:164.fullSentence: This usually leads to a more coherent structure, with a clear introduction, strong supporting points, and a memorable conclusion, which is difficult to achieve when rushing at the last minute.
toefl:se:164.japanese: これは通常、明確な導入部、力強い裏付けとなる論点、印象に残る結論を伴う、より一貫した構成につながりますが、これは土壇場で慌てているときには達成が難しいものです。
toefl:se:164.explanation: rushing at the last minuteで「土壇場で慌てる」という表現。
toefl:se:164.relatedInfo: build a logical flow / avoid a last-minute scramble

toefl:se:165.answer: In addition, early preparation allows for practice and feedback.
toefl:se:165.fullSentence: In addition, early preparation allows for practice and feedback.
toefl:se:165.japanese: さらに、早めの準備は練習とフィードバックを可能にします。
toefl:se:165.explanation: allow forで「〜を可能にする」という表現。
toefl:se:165.relatedInfo: leave room for rehearsal / make time for feedback

toefl:se:166.answer: I can rehearse multiple times, adjust my timing, and refine my slides so they are not crowded or confusing.
toefl:se:166.fullSentence: I can rehearse multiple times, adjust my timing, and refine my slides so they are not crowded or confusing.
toefl:se:166.japanese: 私は何度もリハーサルをし、タイミングを調整し、スライドが詰め込みすぎたり分かりにくくなったりしないよう改善することができます。

toefl:se:167.answer: If I discover weak points or missing data, I still have time to fix them.
toefl:se:167.fullSentence: If I discover weak points or missing data, I still have time to fix them.
keyPhrases: discover weak points or missing data
still have time to fix them
toefl:se:167.japanese: もし弱点や不足しているデータを見つけても、それを直す時間がまだあります。
toefl:se:167.explanation: still have time to doで「まだ〜する時間がある」を表す。
toefl:se:167.relatedInfo: catch gaps early / spot and fix weaknesses

toefl:se:168.answer: This makes me feel calmer and more in control during the actual presentation.
toefl:se:168.fullSentence: This makes me feel calmer and more in control during the actual presentation.
keyPhrases: feel calmer and more in control
toefl:se:168.japanese: これにより、実際の発表中、私はより落ち着いてより自分をコントロールできていると感じられます。
toefl:se:168.explanation: make 人 feel〜で「人に〜と感じさせる」を表す。
toefl:se:168.relatedInfo: stay composed / feel more confident on stage

toefl:se:169.answer: Andrew is right that we need the material to be fresh in our minds, but starting early does not prevent that.
toefl:se:169.fullSentence: Andrew is right that we need the material to be fresh in our minds, but starting early does not prevent that.
keyPhrases: material to be fresh in our minds
starting early does not prevent that
toefl:se:169.japanese: 資料の内容が頭の中で新鮮である必要があるというアンドリューの指摘は正しいですが、早く始めることはそれを妨げません。
toefl:se:169.explanation: prevent thatで「それを妨げる」という表現。
toefl:se:169.relatedInfo: keep the content fresh / does not get in the way of that

toefl:se:170.answer: I can simply review my notes the day before.
toefl:se:170.fullSentence: I can simply review my notes the day before.
toefl:se:170.japanese: 私は単に前日にメモを見直すだけでよいのです。
toefl:se:170.explanation: the day beforeは「その前日に」という時を表す副詞句。
toefl:se:170.relatedInfo: go over my notes beforehand / do a final review

toefl:se:171.answer: Combining early preparation with a final review provides both depth of content and better interaction with the audience.
toefl:se:171.fullSentence: Combining early preparation with a final review provides both depth of content and better interaction with the audience.
keyPhrases: combining early preparation with a final review
toefl:se:171.japanese: 早めの準備と最終的な見直しを組み合わせることで、内容の深さと聴衆とのより良い交流の両方が得られます。
toefl:se:171.explanation: 動名詞Combining〜が主語となる文構造。
toefl:se:171.relatedInfo: balance depth with polish / engage the audience more effectively

toefl:se:172.answer: In my opinion, preparing a presentation far in advance is more effective.
toefl:se:172.fullSentence: In my opinion, preparing a presentation far in advance is more effective.
keyPhrases: preparing a presentation far in advance
toefl:se:172.japanese: 私の意見では、プレゼンを大幅に前もって準備する方がより効果的です。
toefl:se:172.explanation: far in advanceで「大幅に前もって」を表す。
toefl:se:172.relatedInfo: start well ahead of time / prepare well in advance

toefl:se:173.answer: As Kelly mentioned, starting early allows us to ask colleagues for feedback and make useful improvements, which can help make the presentation stronger.
toefl:se:173.fullSentence: As Kelly mentioned, starting early allows us to ask colleagues for feedback and make useful improvements, which can help make the presentation stronger.
toefl:se:173.japanese: ケリーが述べたように、早く始めることで同僚にフィードバックを求め、有益な改善を行うことができ、それがプレゼンをより強力にする助けになります。
toefl:se:173.explanation: allow us to doで「私たちが〜することを可能にする」を表す。
toefl:se:173.relatedInfo: get input from coworkers / gather useful feedback

toefl:se:174.answer: In addition, if we practice and organize the speech ahead of time, we can become more confident and avoid forgetting important points during the actual presentation.
toefl:se:174.fullSentence: In addition, if we practice and organize the speech ahead of time, we can become more confident and avoid forgetting important points during the actual presentation.
keyPhrases: practice and organize the speech ahead of time
toefl:se:174.japanese: さらに、事前にスピーチを練習し構成しておけば、より自信を持てるようになり、実際の発表中に重要な点を忘れることを避けられます。
toefl:se:174.explanation: ahead of timeは「事前に」という意味の副詞句。
toefl:se:174.relatedInfo: rehearse in advance / structure the speech beforehand

toefl:se:175.answer: While Andrew is concerned about forgetting details if we start too early, I think reviewing and practicing along the way can solve this problem.
toefl:se:175.fullSentence: While Andrew is concerned about forgetting details if we start too early, I think reviewing and practicing along the way can solve this problem.
keyPhrases: reviewing and practicing along the way
toefl:se:175.japanese: アンドリューは早く始めすぎると細部を忘れてしまうことを心配していますが、途中で見直しと練習を重ねることでこの問題は解決できると私は思います。
toefl:se:175.explanation: be concerned aboutで「〜を心配している」を表す。
toefl:se:175.relatedInfo: worry about losing detail / keep reviewing along the way

toefl:se:176.answer: Overall, preparing in advance leads to a more polished and effective presentation.
toefl:se:176.fullSentence: Overall, preparing in advance leads to a more polished and effective presentation.
toefl:se:176.japanese: 全体として、事前に準備することは、より洗練され効果的なプレゼンにつながります。
toefl:se:176.explanation: lead toで「〜につながる」という因果関係を表す。
toefl:se:176.relatedInfo: result in a more refined presentation / produce a stronger outcome
